punchline: Two tired school founders in a pub invented a ceremony that made college acceptance visible to sixth graders.
thirty_sec: At YES Prep in Houston every graduate had to be accepted to college. After a 14-hour day, Chris Barbic and Donald Kamentz designed Senior Signing Day: in 2001, 17 seniors were honored before their families and every student from sixth grade up.
question: Which achievement in your team or family usually passes unnoticed, and what shared moment could give it an audience?
key_contrast: A rule sets the standard; a ceremony lets everyone see it.
